name: before_after_backpack
views: the front view with the printed pockets
the back view with the padded shoulder straps
the left side view with a printed side pocket
the top view with the carry handle
story: Before/after. Why: she is late for class and everything has to fit. Empty flat backpack and loose items -> packed -> zipped full -> lifted and checked.
storyboard_prompt: Image 1 is the product photo: use exactly this product, its shape, materials, colours and logos. Create ONE storyboard image made of a 2x2 grid of four equal photo panels, edge to edge, with no borders, no gaps, no text and no numbers. Shot on a 35mm film camera, Kodak Portra 400, visible film grain, slight halation around highlights, natural unretouched colours, a real photograph, not a render. Every panel: First-person view at her eye level looking down about 30 degrees at a worn light oak table by a window, 35mm lens, no zoom, no cuts. Handheld: the frame drifts and bobs slightly with her breathing, focus breathes and lands a moment late. Low warm window daylight from the left, one side of everything lit, soft real shadows falling to the right. Lived-in table: a coffee ring, a few crumbs and a folded receipt, framing slightly off-centre. Only the same young woman's hands and forearms: real skin with fine pores, knuckle creases, a faint vein on the back of the hand, slightly dry fingertips, short soft-pink nails with a tiny chip. Exactly one backpack in each panel: a backpack with a charcoal-grey woven canvas body with a few loose threads, a black zip around the main compartment, a horizontal front zip pocket with a silver zip puller, and a large lower front pocket and two side pockets in a bold African wax print of wavy red, navy blue, cream and mustard stripes. Panel 1 (top left): BEFORE: the empty backpack lies flat and slumped on the table, the main zip open; around it lie a silver laptop, a folded beige sweater, a black notebook and a small dented water bottle. Panel 2 (top right): HALF: the hands slide the silver laptop into the open main compartment; the sweater is already inside, the notebook and water bottle still on the table. Panel 3 (bottom left): AFTER: the backpack stands upright on the table, full and rounded, the canvas pulled tight, both zips closed, the water bottle in the side pocket; the hands rest beside it. Panel 4 (bottom right): AFTER: the right hand lifts the full backpack by its top carry handle, its weight pulling the arm down, the table empty except the coffee ring. The same camera, table, light and hands in all four panels. Candid, unretouched photographs with natural imperfections: real dust, fingerprints, uneven light, slight lens vignetting. No extra products, no added text, no watermark.
